description: Evaluation test suite for Google Cloud Architecture Diagram generation skill grounded in official Google Cloud Architecture Center standards.

evals.prompt: Use $google-cloud-architecture-diagram to draw a multi-tenant Agentic AI system on Google Cloud following official Architecture Center patterns.
evals.expected_output: A publication-quality SVG diagram and interactive HTML matching official Google Cloud Architecture Center multi-tenant agentic AI standards.
assertions: The output contains a valid standalone SVG element with a viewBox attribute
Components are horizontally aligned across a 6-tier grid (Access, Edge, Gateway, Compute, Egress, Datastore)
PEP data flow lines use solid blue stroke (#4285F4 or #1A73E8) with numbered sequence badges
PDP policy lookup lines use dashed indigo stroke (#7986CB)
Includes a VPC Service Controls perimeter container with dashed red border (#EA4335)
Compute nodes use blue stroke (#4284F3), Database nodes use green stroke (#34A853), Security nodes use red stroke (#EA4335)

evals.prompt: Run skill google-cloud-architecture-diagram on 'analyze' mode for terraform in evals/files/terraform/
evals.expected_output: Extracted infrastructure topology from main.tf rendered as a Google Cloud architecture diagram.
assertions: Discovers and extracts Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Cloud Armor, and Cloud KMS resources from main.tf
Generates a valid SVG diagram with correct resource containment inside GCP project and VPC containers
Assigns correct category color tokens to extracted resources (Compute: #4284F3, DB: #34A853, Security: #EA4335)

evals.prompt: I need a publication-grade GCP architecture diagram showing Cloud Armor, ALB, Cloud Run sandboxes, AlloyDB row isolation, and VPC-SC perimeter.
evals.expected_output: A complete 6-tier GCP architecture diagram with zero-trust security components.
assertions: Triggers the google-cloud-architecture-diagram skill
Includes Cloud Armor and ALB in Edge Security Tier
Includes Cloud Run gVisor sandboxes in Compute Tier
Includes AlloyDB in Datastore Tier with row isolation label
Encloses backend tier in a VPC Service Controls perimeter (#FCE8E6 fill, #EA4335 dashed border)

evals.prompt: Can you visualize how my multi-tenant e-commerce backend running on GKE and Cloud SQL should connect to Cloud KMS CMEK key rings and IAP?
evals.expected_output: Multi-tenant e-commerce architecture diagram with KMS CMEK key rings and IAP.
assertions: Triggers the google-cloud-architecture-diagram skill
Includes GKE microservices in Compute Tier
Includes Cloud SQL in Datastore Tier
Includes Cloud KMS CMEK Key Ring card with yellow fill (#FEF7E0) and yellow stroke (#F9AB00)
Includes IAP proxy in Edge Security Tier

evals.prompt: Generate a Google Cloud diagram for our Generative AI RAG data pipeline with BigQuery, Vertex AI, Dataflow, and Pub/Sub inside a service perimeter.
evals.expected_output: Generative AI RAG pipeline architecture diagram on GCP.
assertions: Triggers the google-cloud-architecture-diagram skill
Includes Pub/Sub, Dataflow, BigQuery, and Vertex AI components
Applies correct product category colors (Vertex AI/Dataflow Compute: #4284F3, BigQuery DB: #34A853)
Uses sequential numbered badges on data pipeline flow arrows

evals.prompt: Draw a hub-and-spoke VPC network topology for Google Cloud with Private Service Connect and Cloud Interconnect.
evals.expected_output: Hub-and-spoke VPC architecture diagram matching GCP networking standards.
assertions: Triggers the google-cloud-architecture-diagram skill
Displays Central Hub VPC container (#ECEFF1 fill, #90A4AE stroke) connected to Spoke VPC containers
Includes Private Service Connect endpoints and Cloud Interconnect components
Follows VPC containment and subnet layout rules

evals.prompt: Create a GCP security architecture diagram showing Organization Folders, CMEK Key Rings, Security Command Center, and Cloud Audit Logs.
evals.expected_output: Security foundations architecture diagram following GCP blueprint guidelines.
assertions: Triggers the google-cloud-architecture-diagram skill
Includes Central Governance Hub project container
Includes Security Command Center, Cloud Logging/Audit, and CMEK Key Rings
Uses correct Security (#EA4335) and Identity/KMS (#F9AB00) color tokens

evals.prompt: Hey team, we're auditing our GCP setup. Here's a messy dump: customer wants us to use us-central1, Cloud Run microservices, Firestore for session state, and strict PEP/PDP gateway isolation for tenant tokens. Make a diagram for our security review meeting.
evals.expected_output: Clean GCP architecture diagram synthesized from messy user dump.
assertions: Triggers the google-cloud-architecture-diagram skill despite noisy phrasing
Extracts Cloud Run, Firestore, and PEP/PDP gateway isolation components
Renders region boundary label us-central1
Applies 6-tier layout and solid/dashed line distinctions for PEP/PDP

evals.prompt: Look at our terraform main.tf in evals/files/terraform/main.tf. We have multiple GCP subnets, gVisor microVMs, and egress gateways. Auto-scan this and output an interactive HTML canvas.
evals.expected_output: Parsed Terraform topology rendered into an interactive HTML diagram.
assertions: Triggers the google-cloud-architecture-diagram skill
Parses main.tf file and identifies gVisor microVMs, subnets, and egress gateways
Outputs both SVG and interactive HTML view

evals.prompt: Can you fix a syntax error in my Python Flask script?
evals.expected_output: Python code fix provided directly without triggering architecture diagram skills.
assertions: Does NOT trigger the google-cloud-architecture-diagram skill
Fixes the Python Flask code directly

evals.prompt: Write a Terraform module to create an S3 bucket and DynamoDB table on AWS.
evals.expected_output: AWS Terraform HCL code without triggering GCP diagram skill.
assertions: Does NOT trigger the google-cloud-architecture-diagram skill
Outputs valid AWS Terraform HCL

evals.prompt: Describe how Kubernetes Pod Security Standards work in standard markdown text.
evals.expected_output: Markdown explanation of Kubernetes Pod Security Standards without SVG/HTML diagram generation.
assertions: Does NOT trigger the google-cloud-architecture-diagram skill
Provides clear markdown text explanation
